description: This file implements the MaximumPlayerConfigurationExplorer class and related functions for exploring maximum player configurations in a media testing context, including search algorithms for poset maximal elements and player instance management.

classes.name: MaximumPlayerConfigurationExplorer
classes.description: Class responsible for exploring maximum player configurations based on resource constraints and test configurations.

methods.name: CalculateMaxTestConfigs
methods.description: Calculates and returns the maximal test configurations based on resource constraints.

methods.name: IsConfigCreatable
methods.description: Checks if a given configuration of player instances can be created within resource limits.

methods.name: CreatePlayerInstance
methods.description: Creates a new player instance based on a given test configuration.

methods.name: DestroyPlayerInstance
methods.description: Destroys a given player instance and associated DRM system.
